info.name: Crafting Service
info.description: Tests for Crafting Service (In Kahoots with the Undead, Team 3), run through the Gateway against the real Resource, Player, Exam and World Service of the team docker-compose.yml. Run the folders in order: Setup makes sure the five contract recipes exist, registers a fresh player and grants it resources through Resource Service's refund route. Rollback uses a player id Player Service does not know: with the Two-Phase Commit of 5.0.0 Player Service votes abort and nothing is spent, and with the local saga the delivery fails and the ingredients are refunded. Folders 6 to 9 cover Lab 5 and need the 5.0.0 image with the compose defaults (Coordination__Mode=2pc); start the compose with CACHE_DEBUG_HEADERS=true for the cache checks.

item.name: 6. Cache (Redis, sharded with consistent hashing)
item.description: Needs the 5.0.0 image. Recipe definitions are cached in the team's Redis nodes (keys start with crafting-service:), and creating, updating or deleting a recipe invalidates them all. The player lookups behind the unlock conditions (30 s) and World Service's zones (until a ZoneUnlocked) are cached too. Run the compose with CACHE_DEBUG_HEADERS=true to check X-Cache (MISS / HIT) and X-Cache-Node; without them, those checks are skipped.

item.name: 7. Replication and failover
item.description: Needs the 5.0.0 image (with 4.0.0 the checks are skipped). Reads one replica's GET /status and GET /metrics through the broker's queue: the crafting-db-1..3 nodes, which one is the primary, and the failovers seen. Writes are synchronous: a commit returns only once a standby has it. To see a failover, run `docker stop crafting-db-1` and run the folder again about 30 s later: another node is the primary and primaryChanges went up (on the replicas that noticed it). Until the standby is promoted, the service answers 503 database_unavailable with Retry-After: 2.

item.name: 8. Two-Phase Commit
item.description: Needs the 5.0.0 image with Coordination__Mode=2pc (the team compose default). A craft is one transaction over crafting_db, Resource Service (the ingredients) and Player Service (the item): Resource Service holds the ingredients and votes, then Player Service checks the player and votes. The item and the spend land together, or the hold is released and nothing is delivered. Reads the crafts of folders 3 and 4.

item.name: 9. Saga steps (through the Message Broker)
item.description: Needs the 5.0.0 image. The complete step of the broker's craft-item saga and its compensation, cancel (the saga runs with CRAFTING_COORDINATION_MODE=saga: complete on Crafting Service, pay on Resource Service, then deliver on Player Service, and a craft answers 202 with the sagaId; GET /api/sagas/{sagaId} shows its progress). Only the broker calls the steps, so the Gateway refuses them (from loredana-costin/gateway-service#31) and the collection sends them through the broker's queue with a service token. A cancel always answers 200, also before its step.
